name: ChannelRateParityMonitor
tagline: Win / meet / loss against brand.com on every channel – and the case workflow to fix every leak.
description: A complete hotel rate parity app for Power Apps and Power Pages: classifies rate shop results against your direct rate with per-channel tolerances, detects wholesale leaks and availability parity problems, prices undercut and revenue at risk, scores severity against an SLA and runs each violation from investigation to escalation with evidence and a partner case to re-shop-verified resolution.
features: Win / meet / loss with per-channel and per-type tolerances
Availability parity: selling while closed, sold out while open
Evidence link and partner case required to escalate
Channel scorecard and parity score KPIs
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and ARIA
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control, shared src/app)
